name: prontopaga-riesgo-financiero
description: MVP de Consulta de Riesgo Financiero — API REST segura (Node + TypeScript) y SPA (React + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace @riesgo/api" "npm run dev --workspace @riesgo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @riesgo/api && npm run build --workspace @riesgo/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
